title: REQ · bootSceneBuild suite asserts buildScene receives the mocked sceneSpec
description: bootSceneBuild.test.ts imports sceneSpec from the real content module and reads it for the hardcoded-id check. It must mock the content module and import the mocked sceneSpec for the buildScene assertion.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mocked sceneSpec, when create() runs, then buildScene is called once with the fake render context and that sceneSpec
Given the mocked sceneSpec object ids and assets, when BootScene.ts and renderContext.ts are scanned, then no quoted id appears
technical_constraints: Mocked sceneSpec ids must differ from strings legitimately in source
